cumleler: How does a speech test cross-check the pure tone test?
The speech recognition threshold, or SRT, uses two-syllable words.
It is the lowest level where half the words are repeated correctly.
It is compared with the pure tone average, or PTA.
The two usually agree within plus or minus ten decibels.
If the gap is large, instructions and pure tone thresholds are rechecked.
